answer: An island compute exchange can draw job permits from indivisible token units locked before a public random beacon, not from account names. Each unit has one serial number and one lottery entry; spent entries cannot win twice in the round. If operator zenith divides 100 units among accounts including jade, it still has only 100 entries. No per-account minimum award or rounding bonus is allowed. A swarm must lock more capital for more chances, though wealthy single owners can still dominate.
